title: MI Programmer Art
description: make some elements of Modern Industrialization have a similar appearance to Programmer Art
body:
Simple texture pack that changes Modern Industrialization's ores to have an older look similar to the Programmer Art.

This texture pack was designed and works best alongside:
- Programmer Art (built in)
- [Programmer Art Fix](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/programmer-art-fix)
